a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. A frank concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, the 8-cell plan probably leaves us both short, and the 4 cells in reserve now can only save one of us. If you want to renegotiate, say so openly and we can decide together. I won't take early without telling you first, and I'd ask the same of you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
